review: Recovery59 inventory bootstrap and safe journal independent implementation review
scope: Read-only review of the inventory bootstrap/journal/failed-child finally collector; no caller, CI or product change reviewed or executed

findings.problem: A consumed nonzero SystemExit was validated only after logger cleanup. Cleanup failure replaced the original exit and even successful cleanup moved the recorded failure phase from invocation to cleanup.
findings.resolution: Non-success SystemExit is recorded at the invoke phase before raising the fixed inventory-exit Failure; active execution errors prevent cleanup exceptions from replacing the primary. Unexpected normal return is also rejected and recorded within invocation.
findings.regression: SystemExit7, ordinary Failure and unexpected return, each with cleanup success/failure; original code/phase/exception identity retained where applicable.

findings.problem: Calling real Registrar.register_category for a missing testing category reset an existing commands_by_category testing set in a partial registry.
findings.resolution: Nonempty orphan command membership is rejected with the fixed binding failure before registration. A valid existing category is validated and reused without resetting command membership.
findings.regression: Actual fixed MachRegistrar new/present/orphan/foreign state controls; existing command object and membership preserved; source CATEGORIES parsed as pinned literal without importing mach_initialize.

verifiedSemantics.primary: First execution error and invocation phase survive later journal write and logger cleanup failures.
verifiedSemantics.journal: Only fixed phase/type/code vocabularies are retained. SystemExit kind and bounded strict integer code are typed; bool and free text do not become integer exit codes. Unknown exception class/code remains unavailable/null.
verifiedSemantics.collection: prepare always attempts bounded owned no-follow journal collection after inventory Runner failure. Missing, corrupt, oversized, symlinked, unknown-field, invalid-phase or post-read binding failure yields unavailable journal/receipt without replacing the child primary.
verifiedSemantics.privacy: Exception messages, module names, paths, private extra fields and PRIVATE_SENTINEL are absent from the returned evidence.
verifiedSemantics.bootstrap: The fixed source build/mach_initialize.py bytes/hash and AST literal testing metadata are verified, then the official Registrar API is used only for an empty missing category. Existing valid category commands are retained.
verifiedSemantics.productBoundary: The journal remains diagnostic; no source manifest, compilation profile, resource/timeout/cleanup limit, SDK expiry or product qualification gate was relaxed.

remainingEvidence: Recovery59 caller and prelaunch guards need their own immutable review.
Actual Mac inventory execution and45-case results are not supplied by these local controls.
Recovery58 remains a failed inventory-start attempt with45 tests unexecuted; this review does not retroactively establish its exact Mac exception cause.
